svg.title: Shear, acoustic and collapse times in the same geometry
svg.desc: Length Rmax controls shear crossing Rmax/cs, acoustic crossing Rmax/cL and ideal collapse Rmax sqrt(rho/Delta p). G determines cs; bulk modulus determines longitudinal sound speed.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Static softness does not specify the pulse response
